acceptance.note: Phase 1/3 gate G1/G3: tip deflection within 5% of Euler-Bernoulli closed form on asymptotic refinement levels (p=1 coarse meshes lock in bending and are diagnostic/non-gated; relaxed to 10% for slowest-converging studies).

boundary_conditions.clamp: z = 0 end face pinned (all translations fixed)

line_probes.midspan_section: x = 0, y in [-h/2, h/2], z = L/2 = 0.5 (sigma_zz, tau_zy)
line_probes.top_fiber: x = 0, y = h/2 = 0.05, z in [0, L] (sigma_zz)

moment.target: tip reference point at end-face centroid via kinematic coupling

materials.note_nu_zero: Poisson's ratio intentionally zero so the 3D solid matches Euler-Bernoulli kinematics without Poisson effect.

mesh_sweep.discretization: immersed trimmed U-splines, structured rectilinear background grid, p padding elements per side
mesh_sweep.note: Follower and resultant traction variants are single-level coverage cases.
